svg.text: Junction close-up — dirt spur meeting the asphalt main, ±30 m
Curvature again. Both ditches fade into a crown-only apron; the blend disc is R = 21.9 m, scaled by 1/sinθ (0.732) so it covers the acute-angle overlap.
Curvature p99.9 over junction cells: 9.27 /m nearest-road → 3.019 /m blended — below the road's own 2.989 /m, so junctions are no longer the sharpest feature in the bake.
